informational: Gate race: the direct gate runs 'xtask tests that run no products' beside 'cargo xtask so', but so::tests::a_product_build_leaves_no_earlier_product_for_the_manifest_lint reads the real target/niji; it failed because target/niji/locale-sources was being rewritten (SUPPORTED mtime 14:48:16, libc.so.6 14:47:35, inside the test window). Passed when rerun alone. Suggest: mark it as using the products in the affected classification. Not changed here (outside this story).
COMPAT-43 reserved and unused: the three differences rows give no-compat reasons.
pldd's ELFCLASS32 path is NOT VERIFIED: the host has no 32-bit target.
Challenge to the brief: tzselect is a separate C front end beside zic and zdump, not an argv[0] command of niji-tz (the tz tools are already separate front ends).

t2, plants and rootsys1 ran on earlier heads (1fd1901ea, 33097e147); the later commits change only root-system.sh (rootsys1 ran it), the plants file and two clippy lints in the test file (no behaviour change).

impact.what: /usr/bin/tzselect, /usr/bin/pldd and /usr/bin/ld.so present in libc-bin (GitHub #14's remaining utilities)

improvement: The gate's 'xtask tests that run no products' step should not include tests that read target/niji (one raced the concurrent products build here); also probe scripts should record the exact argv they ran (a leg-1 summary of 'pldd -5' disagreed with a direct run).
